title.narrative: Community Radio Program to Improve the Health of Women and Children in Zambia

description.narrative: (Zambia): The Community Radio Program (CRP) will continue to improve the health of women and children and addresses voluntary family planning, nutrition, gender-based violence, malaria and HIV, with a special focus on adolescents as well as immunization and treatment of childhood illnesses, through the production and airing of radio serial dramas (RSD) on community radio stations around the country. With FY 2020 funds, CRP will build on successes and lessons learned from the Kwishilya and Siñalamba dramas aired in Central, Luapula, Muchinga, Western and Northern Provinces, to produce additional episodes of the RSD. CRP will continue to support improved health, and health-seeking behaviors, risk communication and community engagement around key health issues and behaviors. CRP will also continue to leverage broadcasting on the 14 community and commercial stations which have been established since January 2019. Under USAID's Country Development Cooperation Strategy, the mechanism will support Development Objective 3: Capacity of Zambia's Government, Citizens and Private Sector Increased to Improve Health Outcomes and Meet Critical Needs of Vulnerable Populations.. ... .
